latest_primary_effect_experiment.label: PrimaryEffects WindowsFix
limits: Mock all-negative responses forecast request envelopes; they do not measure F1.
28 source proof fixtures use explicitly synthetic semantic flags; source compatibility is not semantic accuracy.
147 selected public baseline lines change inference context while fixed S0 and all 53 history artifacts retain their bytes.
No completed primary API receipt/report/metrics has been supplied at catalog creation.

limitations: Single curated KEP1287 repository case repeatedly inspected for development; no held-out performance established.
Different semantic profiles, inference context, judge models and request budgets prevent equal-compute causal claims.
Opaque model IDs are reused; immutable provider snapshots are unverified.
The strongest observed all-scope result is v4.9 0.636364; strongest baseline-subset result is v4.6 0.689655. No result above 0.80 is established.
All-hosted report outcomes are recommendations with unresolved human review, without outcome Gold; link F1 is not architecture-outcome accuracy.
Provider token fields are recorded usage, not monetary billing. Scope experiment adds 3 checker requests on reused v4.9 primary predictions; primary compute was not free.
Reported historical test reports are local construction validation and synthetic workflow checks, not hosted accuracy.
GitHub export can preserve provenance but does not independently authenticate reviewer declarations or external service responses.
required_export_inference_input_note: Each run original_diagnostic_members already contains its exact unlabeled S0/history. Current PrimaryEffects also needs data/public_baseline_README.md from the WindowsFix kit, pinned by its module and release validation; extra baseline context changes inference inputs and has no hosted F1 yet.
required_export_members_policy: Copy only original_diagnostic_members per record, preserving bytes. Extra FP/FN analyses and *_case.json files are development analysis, not committed hosted run members.
